cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
Chrome 官方出了份指南
一周从日增 15 星冲到 4,139
cover.dek: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance 让 coding agent 跟上最新的 Web 最佳实践，11-10 前后起量，今天日增 +2223。HN 的 Show HN 帖拿了 448 分、146 评论，是今天最强的自发讨论。
cover.title_en:
Chrome's official guide for agents
went from 15 stars a day to 4,139
cover.dek_en: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance helps coding agents keep up with current web best practices. It gained +2,223 stars today, and its Show HN post drew 448 points and 146 comments, the strongest organic discussion of the day.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: Experience Rot 发现工具被静默变更后，带经验的 Agent 反而不如新手。
stickers.text_en: Experience Rot finds that after a silent tool change, agents with experience do worse than novices.

stickers.title: 省 token
stickers.text: Beyond Plain MCP 测得 code mode 比普通 MCP 省 70–90% token。
stickers.text_en: Beyond Plain MCP measures code mode using 70–90% fewer tokens than plain MCP.

stickers.title: 补课
stickers.text: skill 越来越多，NVIDIA 同时放出 SkillEvaluator 和 SkillSpector，做评测与安全检查。
stickers.text_en: With skills multiplying, NVIDIA now has both SkillEvaluator and SkillSpector for evaluation and security checks.
